title: An X-linked recessive cross: a carrier mother
caption: The haemophilia allele Xʰ is on the X chromosome. A carrier mother passes Xʰ to half her gametes, so half her sons are affected and half her daughters are carriers. The father passes his Y to every son and his Xᴴ to every daughter.
alt: A Punnett square of a carrier mother and an unaffected father: one unaffected daughter, one carrier daughter, one unaffected son and one son with haemophilia.
description: Mother XᴴXʰ is a carrier; father XᴴY is unaffected.
Her eggs carry Xᴴ or Xʰ; his sperm carry Xᴴ or Y.
Daughters: one XᴴXᴴ unaffected, one XᴴXʰ carrier. Sons: one XᴴY unaffected, one XʰY with haemophilia.
Half of the sons are affected and half of the daughters are carriers.
